title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Stockport £30,000 per annum + study + benefits

Join a successful manufacturing business where your contribution really counts.

Are you an organised, detail-oriented finance professional looking for your next opportunity within a supportive team? This is a great opportunity to join an established packaging business in Stockport, as an Accounts Assistant, supporting the day-to-day running of the finance function.

Reporting directly to the Finance Manager, you ll play an important role in keeping financial records accurate, ensuring transactions are processed efficiently and helping the business maintain effective financial controls.

This is a varied, hands-on position offering the opportunity to build on your existing accounts experience, develop your skills and gain broader exposure to the finance function.

The role

Working closely with the Finance Manager and wider business, your responsibilities will include:
- Processing purchase invoices and credit notes, ensuring accurate coding, supporting documentation and approvals.
- Maintaining customer and supplier accounts and allocating receipts and payments.
- Completing bank reconciliations and investigating discrepancies or unreconciled transactions.
- Supporting credit control by monitoring outstanding balances, issuing statements and following up overdue invoices.
- Checking employee expenses and maintaining petty cash records.
- Assisting with month-end activities, including ledger checks, accruals, prepayments and supporting schedules.
- Providing financial information for VAT returns, audits and management reporting.
- Responding to customer and supplier queries professionally and helping resolve issues promptly.
- Maintaining accurate, organised and confidential financial records.
- Identifying opportunities to improve routine processes and supporting the wider finance team as required.

About you

You ll be numerate, methodical and comfortable working with financial information, with a strong eye for detail and a proactive approach to getting things done.

We re looking for someone with:
- A good understanding of basic bookkeeping and purchase and sales ledger processes.
- Strong numerical skills and a high level of accuracy.
- Confidence using Microsoft Excel, including basic formulas, sorting and filtering.
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and meet deadlines.
- Clear communication skills and a professional approach to customer and supplier queries.
- The ability to work independently on routine tasks while contributing positively to a team.
- A responsible approach to confidentiality and sensitive financial information.

Previous experience in an accounts, bookkeeping or finance administration role would be advantageous. AAT qualified, studying towards AAT, or equivalent practical experience would also be welcomed.

Experience with bank reconciliations, credit control, month-end processes or accounting software would be beneficial, although a willingness to learn is just as important.

What s on offer?
- £30,000 annual salary plus benefits
- The opportunity to join an established business.
- A varied role with exposure to several areas of finance.
- Direct support and development from the Finance Manager.
- The opportunity to strengthen your accounting skills and develop your experience within a busy finance function.

Interested?

If you re looking for a hands-on Accounts Assistant role where you can make a valuable contribution, build your experience and become part of a supportive finance team, we d love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more.

title: Accounts Assistant

title: Global Shipping, Logistics & Aftersales Coordinator
description:
Global Shipping, Logistics & Aftersales Coordinator Industrial components & industrial equipment

Location: Manchester, SK6 6 AF
Starting Salary: £30k £35 K per annum, DOE
Contract: Full time, Permanent
Working hours: 40 hr/week, Monday to Friday, 8am to 5pm, 1hr lunch
Benefits: Opportunities to develop into more senior roles as the company grows, flexible working environment and supportive team culture, hands-on experience and a chance to make a genuine impact in a growing business!

We are JV International, a small but growing company supporting production plants with critical spare parts and components.

Based in the UK, we are a dynamic and innovative global project, procurement and engineering company committed to delivering top-notch solutions to meet the evolving needs of current and potential clients.

Our size means every team member plays a key role, you won t be just a number here! Instead, you ll have the chance to make a real impact, gain broad exposure, and grow your career as we continue to expand.

We are currently recruiting for a new team member to own the area of our shipping, logistics and aftersales support, with a stronger focus on global shipping within this role.

This is the ideal for someone with experience in both air and sea freight who enjoys variety, autonomy, and working closely with external providers and other internal departments to deliver exceptional results.

As our Global Shipping, Logistics & Aftersales team member you will:
- Solely responsible for logistics, shipping and aftersales for all our international sales.
- Coordinate and oversee the delivery of products domestically & internationally.
- Prepare and check shipping documents and liaise with shipping line.
- Assist with aftersales despatch issues and ensure customer complaints resolved quickly.
- Build and maintain strong logistics and customer relationships.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure accurate forecasted shipping costs & timely deliveries.
- Liaise with our warehouse to ensure timely inbound and outbound shipments
- Contribute to cost-saving initiatives and revenue growth strategies.

In order to be successful in this role you must have:
- Experience in international logistics and shipping including exporting/importing goods internationally.
- Knowledge of shipping documentation (Bills of Lading, commercial invoices, CoO, LOC and COC
- Certified for Dangerous Goods.
- Experience of Sage is preferred
- Experience of the workings of a warehouse desirable.
- Strong communication and relationship building skills with shipping agents/freight forwarders and customers.
- Comfortable managing multiple priorities in a small, dynamic team environment.
- Commercially aware, adaptable, and eager to grow with the business.
- Full UK driving licence essential & Forklift licence would be preferable

title: Post Appointment Insolvency Administrator
description:
Post-Appointment Corporate Insolvency Administrator

Location: Stockport

Working arrangements: Hybrid

Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience

Develop your corporate insolvency career with a specialist firm offering varied casework and hybrid working.

Imperium Financial Recruitment is recruiting a Post-Appointment Corporate Insolvency Administrator to join a firm of Insolvency Specialists based in Stockport.

This opportunity would suit someone with practical corporate insolvency experience who enjoys taking responsibility for case progression, resolving queries and working with a range of stakeholders.

You will focus on the administration of corporate insolvency cases following appointment, working closely with Insolvency Practitioners and senior colleagues to progress assignments through to closure.

The role

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing an allocated portfolio of post-appointment corporate insolvency cases under appropriate supervision.
- Preparing statutory reports, notices, correspondence and supporting case documentation.
- Liaising with directors, creditors, solicitors, agents, accountants and other relevant parties.
- Gathering and reviewing company books, records and financial information.
- Assisting with the identification, protection and realisation of company assets.
- Supporting investigations into company affairs and highlighting matters requiring further review.
- Reviewing creditor claims and assisting with distributions.
- Monitoring statutory deadlines and following up on outstanding actions.
- Maintaining accurate case records and updating the case management system.
- Liaising with the cashiering team regarding receipts, payments and account reconciliations.
- Providing clear progress updates to managers and Insolvency Practitioners.
- Preparing cases for closure and ensuring outstanding matters are addressed.

About you

Previous experience in corporate insolvency administration, including post-appointment casework, is essential.

You will also bring:
- A working knowledge of corporate insolvency procedures, particularly Creditors' Voluntary Liquidations.
- Experience progressing cases and preparing accurate documentation.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing deadlines.
- Clear written and verbal communication skills.
- Confidence dealing professionally with directors, creditors and external advisers.
- A proactive approach to resolving queries and moving cases forward.
- Good attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining complete case files.
- The ability to work independently within your experience level and seek guidance when needed.

A relevant insolvency qualification, such as the CPI, would be advantageous but is not essential where suitable practical experience can be demonstrated.

The opportunity
- Hybrid working, combining time at home with attendance at the Stockport office.
- A dedicated focus on post-appointment corporate insolvency work.
- Exposure to varied cases within a specialist practice.
- The opportunity to build your technical knowledge alongside experienced insolvency professionals.
- Scope to take on greater case responsibility as your experience develops.
